audit_name: Recruiter Pilot Inter-Annotator Reliability Analysis & Mathematical Specification

declaration_of_scientific_integrity.cardinal_prohibition: Under strict audit rules, NO synthetic or LLM-generated recruiter ratings were manufactured. Metrics are maintained as pending until actual human recruiters complete independent blinded evaluations.

input_schema.annotator_1_rating: int {0: No Fit, 1: Potential Fit, 2: Good Fit}
input_schema.annotator_2_rating: int {0: No Fit, 1: Potential Fit, 2: Good Fit}

mathematical_formulas_verified.linear_weighted_kappa: kappa_linear = 1 - (sum v_ij * O_ij) / (sum v_ij * E_ij) where v_ij = |i - j| / (K - 1)
mathematical_formulas_verified.quadratic_weighted_kappa: kappa_quadratic = 1 - (sum v_ij * O_ij) / (sum v_ij * E_ij) where v_ij = ((i - j) / (K - 1))^2
mathematical_formulas_verified.gwet_ac1: AC1 = (P_o - P_e_gamma) / (1 - P_e_gamma) where P_e_gamma = 1/(K-1) * sum pi_k * (1 - pi_k) and pi_k = (p_k. + p_.k) / 2

quality_gates.remediation_action_if_gate_fails: Batch rejection, rubric ambiguity workshop, fresh re-annotation.
